# Context policy


Every bounded model-facing field the runtime projects, generated from `PROJECTION_POLICY` and `FIELD_KEYS` in `src/app/projection.ts` (docs/015 D2). A field names a closed policy from `inline`, `near`, `far`, `stub`, `pointer`; call sites pass a field descriptor to `project()` and never slice model-facing text themselves. Widths are inline characters; a resource names where a followable field reveals the rest.

Policies: inline, near, far, stub, pointer. Styles: plain, collapse, ellipsis. Surfaces: orchestrator, worker, lead, reviewer.

| Field | Policy | Width | Style | Resource | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assessment.trigger` | inline | 4000 | ellipsis |  | The trigger that opened an Eval is read whole, or cut at its bound. |
| `assessment.near` | near | 1200 | ellipsis |  | The two messages nearest the trigger in the first thread window. |
| `assessment.window` | far | 400 | ellipsis |  | Other messages of the first thread window; the rest is read with orchestrator_eval_read. |
| `assessment.stub` | stub | 50 | collapse |  | A one-line preview of a message the window did not load. |
| `card.trigger` | stub | 160 | collapse | trigger | The trigger preview in a Ticket or Request card. |
| `card.ticket` | stub | 80 | collapse |  | A Ticket preview in a card or link list. |
| `card.input` | stub | 80 | collapse |  | The Input preview in a delivery: the old INPUT_TEXT width. |
| `card.report` | stub | 100 | collapse |  | The latest report summary in a Ticket card. |
| `card.error` | stub | 160 | collapse |  | A source or thread error preview shown on a card. |
| `card.transcript` | stub | 80 | collapse |  | One transcript message preview. |
| `notice.summary` | far | 600 | plain |  | A result summary in a notice, cut with its length kept. |
| `lead.fact` | far | 1200 | plain |  | The Input body the Lead receives with a fact request. |
| `fact.pending` | stub | 200 | collapse |  | The one-line Input preview in a fact-pending notice. |
| `worker.prompt` | pointer | 0 | plain |  | A worker prompt always arrives whole; the pointer is the Ticket. |
| `worker.trigger` | far | 600 | ellipsis | trigger | The source Trigger a worker receives with its first assignment message. |
| `worker.assignment` | far | 1500 | ellipsis | ticket | The assignment text in a worker delivery or activation. |
| `worker.input` | far | 1500 | ellipsis | ticket | An Input carried to a running worker. |
| `worker.nudge` | stub | 200 | collapse |  | The error text quoted in a passing-failure nudge. |
| `notice.request` | stub | 200 | collapse |  | The Request title quoted in its ending notice. |
| `diagnosis.rootCause` | inline | 4000 | plain |  | The incident diagnosis model reads the root cause whole. |
